package rulefixtures

import (
	"context"
	"log"
	"net/http"
)

// scenario for handler_and_service_both_log_same_error_chain: Duplicated logging ownership where both service and handler log the same failure.
// fixture polarity: positive; family: architecture; severity: info.
type Rule068PositiveService struct{}

func (s *Rule068PositiveService) GetUser(ctx context.Context, id string) (string, error) {
	result, err := fetchUser(id)
	if err != nil {
		log.Printf("service: failed to fetch user %s: %v", id, err)
		return "", err
	}
	return result, nil
}

func scenario068Positive(w http.ResponseWriter, r *http.Request) {
	svc := &Rule068PositiveService{}
	id := r.URL.Query().Get("id")
	name, err := svc.GetUser(r.Context(), id)
	if err != nil {
		log.Printf("handler: GetUser failed for %s: %v", id, err)
		http.Error(w, "internal error", http.StatusInternalServerError)
		return
	}
	w.Write([]byte(name))
}

func fetchUser(id string) (string, error) {
	return "user_" + id, nil
}
